en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2861 - Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, Hisham ibn Salim, Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, and others narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:

"If people were to abandon the Hajj, it would be incumbent upon the leader to compel them to perform it and to remain at the sacred site. And if they were to abandon the visitation of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), it would be incumbent upon the leader to compel them to perform it and to remain there. If they did not have sufficient wealth, he should spend on them from the public treasury of the Muslims."
